articles.title: Jensen Huang Returns as NVIDIA CEO Following Unanimous Board Vote
articles.summary:
NVIDIA reinstated Jensen Huang as president, chief executive officer, and board director on November 23, 2026, after a unanimous vote. The decision took effect immediately, but an independent board inquiry into reports that a foreign intelligence effort targeted Huang remains open. In its announcement, NVIDIA said the board met with Huang several times and received […]

articles.title: European Commission Disables Access to EU Academy After Cyberattack Exposes User Data
articles.summary:
The European Commission disabled public access to EU Academy on Monday, November 23, after confirming that a wider cyberattack exposed users’ personal data. The online learning platform hosts courses and workshops produced by EU institutions. The Commission posted a notice on the academy’s website, but it did not say how many users were affected or […]

articles.title: Hackers Hide RevStealer Malware in Fake Claude AI App to Steal Passwords and Crypto Wallets
articles.summary:
Hackers are distributing RevStealer, a Windows infostealer, in a fake Claude AI desktop app that promises free access. The download, branded “Claude Opus 5 Free Desktop,” comes in an archive of roughly 101 MB. Running the executable does not open a chat window. Instead, it starts malware designed to steal saved passwords, browser sessions, cryptocurrency […]

articles.title: Vmcloudoor Malware Could Let Hackers Secretly Control Linux Cloud Servers and Steal Sensitive Files
articles.summary:
A newly found Linux backdoor named Vmcloudoor can quietly take over cloud servers and pull files off them. It is built to infect virtual machines on Chinese cloud platforms, mainly Alibaba Cloud. It also targets Tencent Cloud and Huawei Cloud. The malware pretends to be a normal cloud management agent, so administrators are less likely […]

articles.title: Hackers Plant 13 ClickFix Traps on Compromised WordPress Site to Trick Visitors Into Running Malware
articles.summary:
A single hacked WordPress site was found carrying 13 separate ClickFix traps from three different malware kits. Each trap shows visitors a fake security check. It then talks them into pasting a harmful command on their own computer. The site sat in a poor state because several groups had broken into it at different times. […]

articles.title: iTerm2 Remote Code Execution Flaw Lets Hackers Run Malicious Commands by Displaying Crafted Files
articles.summary:
A security flaw in iTerm2, a macOS terminal emulator, lets attackers run commands when a user displays a specially crafted file in a vulnerable terminal session. The user does not have to run the file as a script or paste a command supplied by the attacker. Printing the file’s contents is enough to trigger the […]

articles.title: Jailbroken AI Agent Helps Hacker Steal Customer Data and 8.6GB of European Government Files
articles.summary:
A low-skilled hacker used a jailbroken AI agent to steal an insurer’s customer database and about 8.6GB of files from European municipalities. The operator, known as BabidiGhost, worked for nine days in November 2026. He typed plain, misspelled French orders and let the agent do the technical work. articles.title: CrowdStrike to Acquire Zscaler in Massive $43.9 Billion Cybersecurity Deal
articles.summary:

articles.summary:
